scope: Targeted continuation of four source research directions; not exhaustive literature priority or full-repository audit.

claims.label: hn:thm:newton
claims.qualification: All spectral s; Re a>0; u away from negative integers. Depth r extends to Re a>-r.

claims.label: hn:cor:jets
claims.qualification: Finite ordinary-zeta reduction remains open in general.

claims.label: hn:thm:AKbridge
claims.qualification: Descending-index convention; no claim to introduce AK functions.

claims.label: hn:eq:boundary-primitives
claims.qualification: Re x>0; m,k>=0 and positive integration order.

claims.label: dg:polynomial
claims.qualification: Includes every finite small-index term and normally convergent quotient.

claims.label: dg:all-parameter
claims.qualification: All mixed parameter orders at b=c=1, for a>0.

claims.label: dg:square
claims.qualification: Holomorphic Re a>0; square is algebraic at complex a.

claims.label: dg:spectral
claims.qualification: Apparent t=0 pole cancels; all fixed derivatives termwise in one bracket.

claims.label: tw:tailtheorem
claims.qualification: Real noninteger distinct twists; finite exceptional modes retained.

claims.label: tw:jets
claims.qualification: Convolution of periodic distributions, not pointwise multiplication.

claims.label: tw:classification
claims.qualification: Not a sampled-value or arithmetic independence theorem.

claims.label: cl:collision
claims.qualification: Fixed positive rates 0<a<b, right ambient cutoff, includes finite anomaly.

claims.label: cl:finite-anomaly
claims.qualification: Does not refute any proved separated-grid or bilinear theorem.

claims.label: cl:allfactor
claims.qualification: Positive integer frequencies, real shifts, all argument/Stieltjes indices.

claims.label: cl:chambers
claims.qualification: For r=(1,0,0); zero-derivative special case is explicitly distinguished.

claims.label: cl:equal-index-cancellation
claims.qualification: d>=1,m>=1; follows from the exact endpoint total derivative.

claims.label: cycloquot:conj:S6
claims.qualification: No new proof or disproof in this package.

claims.label: s8new:conj:S8
claims.qualification: Different from the older source-rejected S8 vector.
Neither numerical tests nor finite formal exclusions imply it.
Analytic proofs and finite exact calculations are distinguished.
